claims.title: A finite categorical mixture prior is identifiable exactly when its component emission rows are affinely independent
claims.scope: finite rational categorical channel K with a latent prior on its rows and exact observed mixture law pi K
assumptions: latent mixing weights lie on the probability simplex
nonclaims: identifiability does not imply small-sample estimability
the result is not evidence for simulation

claims.title: Affine-rank failure yields two explicit distinct rational priors with exactly the same observed law
claims.scope: rank-deficient finite rational categorical mixture channels
assumptions: the null direction is scaled inside the probability simplex
nonclaims: the returned collision is not asserted unique

claims.title: Any invertible affine coordinate minor gives an exact rational reconstruction of latent prior differences on the channel tangent image
claims.scope: full-affine-rank finite rational categorical mixture channels
assumptions: the observed difference lies in the image of the declared channel
the selected square difference minor is invertible
nonclaims: arbitrary off-model observed vectors are not projected onto the channel image

claims.title: Coordinate-minor reconstruction supplies a fail-closed inverse total-variation conditioning bound
claims.scope: full-affine-rank finite rational categorical channels with a completed bounded coordinate-minor search
assumptions: the selected-coordinate L1 mass is bounded using the zero-sum observed difference
all arithmetic is exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: the coordinate-minor constant is not asserted globally optimal

claims.title: The optimal inverse TV modulus is the reciprocal of the minimum TV distance between convex hulls of disjoint latent row subsets
claims.scope: finite categorical mixture channels, normalized nonzero zero-sum latent perturbations
assumptions: positive and negative parts of a normalized zero-sum perturbation are treated as disjoint-support probability mixtures
nonclaims: the current coordinate-minor solver does not yet optimize this global modulus

claims.title: Affine independence is equivalent to strictly positive disjoint-face TV separation
claims.scope: finite categorical channel rows viewed as points in the observed probability simplex
nonclaims: positive separation can still be arbitrarily small across different channel families

claims.title: A symmetric binary noisy channel with row TV separation one-half has certified inverse TV constant two
nonclaims: the numerical constant is specific to this channel

claims.title: Identity K3 exposes conservatism of the generic coordinate-minor conditioning certificate
claims.scope: three latent components emitted through the identity K3 channel
assumptions: TV is computed on both latent and observed simplices
nonclaims: a conservative certificate is not a failure of identifiability

claims.title: Bounded exact finite-mixture affine-identifiability audit
claims.scope: binary exact boundaries plus all three-row channels drawn from the denominator-two ternary simplex and denominator-three latent-prior test grid
assumptions: all probabilities use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded exhaustive checks are not a scalability theorem
CI success is not empirical evidence for simulation
